name: Sanjou Hayato
source:
Prime Minister of Japan (99th).
A powerful political operator who secured a majority in the most recent House of Councillors election and has been pushing through legislation related to the IAF and other matters one after another. Smooth in manner yet sharp and shrewd, he possesses outstanding qualities as a politician. Treats Sonogi warmly.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
